system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
The hinge swings either way. You decide which way every turn.

At the start of each of your turns, declare a stance for that turn — Advance or Anchor. The chosen stance ends at the start of your next turn.

  • Advance. All Ruin Charge spends made this turn are reduced by 1 (minimum 1). You also gain +2 squares of movement on this turn.

  • Anchor. Each Frame Die spent on absorption this turn grants an additional 1d4 of conversion value (added to the d8 base). You cannot be moved against your will until the start of your next turn (no defense check required by you).

You may change stance once during your turn as a free action; the new stance applies retroactively to spends made this turn (refunds the cost difference if applicable).

system.requirements: Path of the Cataclyst, Bulwark Initiation 5
